::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded by ex-Intel and ex-AMD veterans, designing AI GPUs from the ground up. Vinod Dham ('Father of the Pentium') is founding advisor. One of the few Indian startups attempting high-performance GPU design.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Full-stack AI compute platform — custom GPU hardware plus software stack including compilers, libraries, system software, and AI frameworks.
